notes.title: Oculus Touch support added!
notes.content: Those of you with Oculus Touch and at least 2m x 2m of tracked space can now smash your way through New York City!

notes.title: A smashing launch!
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who has enjoyed the game so far! The support has exceeded my expectations, and I really appreciate the thoughtful feedback I've received. 

Later this week I will be rolling out official support for the Oculus Rift, so keep an eye out for that.
